title: Ayurveda Nearly Cost a Girl Her Life
description:
A 14-year-old girl from Kerala nearly lost her life — not because of her illness, but because of Ayurveda. For years she was given so-called herbal concoctions for seizures. What her family didn’t know was that these mixtures were laced with alcohol, toxic chemicals, arsenic, and even modern drugs like clonazepam hidden inside.

Her liver biopsy showed damage identical to alcoholic liver disease. Later tests revealed arsenic poisoning as the cause of her chronic liver damage. This was not healing — this was poisoning under the label of “heritage medicine.”

In this video, Pale Blue Thoughts explains how unproven AYUSH therapies exploit people’s faith, how dangerous adulteration in Ayurveda goes unchecked, and why scientific medicine remains the only evidence-based path for treatment. With insights from Dr. Abby Philips (LiverDoc) and Dr. Arif Hussain, we show how pseudoscience nearly killed a young girl, leaving her with lifelong health risks.

If you’ve searched for “Ayurveda dangers,” “Ayurvedic medicine side effects,” “arsenic in ayurveda,” “clonazepam ayurvedic mix,” “ayush scam,” “liver damage ayurveda,” or “why Ayurveda is dangerous”, this video reveals the shocking truth behind the myth of “natural” medicine. Share this widely so more families don’t fall into the same trap.
